The change that stopped the redundant query is PR #6346 (commit `c21a7cbfa2c9f67c1991372a343217e949e04f44`, merged 2026-07-17). It makes `HibernateConceptDAO` skip the ConceptName full-text search whenever a concept is supplied. The fix lives in `openmrs-core`, in the `api` module's Hibernate DAO.

**The fix.** In `newDrugQuery`, the concept-name search now runs only when `concept == null`. The line is `if (searchDrugConceptNames && concept == null)`, with a comment explaining the skip. This is `openmrs-core/api/src/main/java/org/openmrs/api/db/hibernate/HibernateConceptDAO.java:1582-1583`, and the surrounding method is at lines 1574-1593. The PR body says the change restores pre-2.8.x behaviour and gives a modest performance boost.

**Tests.** PR #6346 adds two tests to `HibernateConceptDAOTest.java`. One checks that a supplied concept skips the concept-name lookup, and the other checks that the lookup still runs when no concept is given. The test data set gains concept 20 ("ZEBRACONCEPT") and its drug "Placebo-X" to exercise this.

**Ticket and PR.** TRUNK-6683 is the ticket. Falkon's ticket lookup returned only PR #6346 and no commits, so the commit comes from the PR's merge-commit link.

Evidence, best first:

- `openmrs-core/api/src/main/java/org/openmrs/api/db/hibernate/HibernateConceptDAO.java:1576-1593` (the fix, as it stands at HEAD)
- `openmrs-core/api/src/test/java/org/openmrs/api/db/hibernate/HibernateConceptDAOTest.java:125-157` (new tests)
- `openmrs-core/api/src/test/resources/org/openmrs/api/db/hibernate/include/HibernateConceptTestDataSet.xml:46-49` (new test data)
